about: The wolf on alert (ALERT in docs/design/HUNTING.md section 2, the head-up tell a player reads): four poses of the body's own Alert, played by time: ahead, a slow look to one side, ahead with the nose up, a look to the other. The head and chest rise through the chest bone, the head keeps its standing angle, the forelegs stand straight and the tail lifts a little above level. The ears carry no weight: side-on and toward the camera the pose reads by the raised head and the tail, and from behind by the ears standing up and the gap the lifted tail leaves between the hind legs.
